floors.title: Lobby
floors.subtitle: Prompting, conversational AI.
floors.description:
You login to ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude.ai. You talk to your AI, copy and paste, and get useful output quickly.

Other things

.
floors.welcome: Welcome aboard. You are at Ground Floor. Scroll up to ride the AI Elevator.

floors.title: Editor Dialog
floors.subtitle: You and the model are both writing code.
floors.description: Inside an editor, you stay in dialog with the model while it helps generate implementation as you iterate.

floors.title: Tooling Fluency
floors.subtitle: Plan mode and approvals improve speed.
floors.description: You start using command workflows. The editor can modify code for you while you approve actions and keep momentum.

floors.title: One-Shot Thinking
floors.subtitle: From back-and-forth chat to stronger one-shots.
floors.description: You rely more on structured instructions and preset rules. You write less code directly and focus on outcome quality.

floors.title: Rules as Infrastructure
floors.subtitle: Editor and terminal become one loop.
floors.description: You keep rules in markdown and auto-load them into sessions so behavior is consistent and reusable.

floors.title: Parallel Sessions
floors.subtitle: More than one agent session at a time.
floors.description: You run sessions in parallel, compare outputs, and share working patterns with other engineers.

floors.title: Structured Decomposition
floors.subtitle: One-shots evolve into epics and tasks.
floors.description: You experiment with beads and drive agents with decomposed work rather than only ad-hoc prompts.

floors.title: Automation Discipline
floors.subtitle: Conversation moves to architecture and verification.
floors.description: You are less conversational during coding and more conversational during requirements, decomposition, and rigor.

floors.title: Spec-Driven Work
floors.subtitle: Specifications generate beads that generate execution.
floors.description: You are comfortable letting agents run over prepared structures and frameworks you maintain.

floors.title: Verification First
floors.subtitle: Consensus and verification are core loops.
floors.description: You accept hallucinations as an operating constraint and design systems around checks, councils, and confidence.

floors.title: Authoring the Stack
floors.subtitle: You build your own primitives.
floors.description: You are writing your own beads and frameworks. You are not just using the elevator anymore, you are building it.
